evidence: All three scored dimensions are mode = "batched" (scored/{functional,polish,visual}/judge.toml:3) with aggregation = weighted_mean, and each prompt explicitly instructs independent scoring and continuation: functional/prompt.md:13 'Once it succeeds, score EACH criterion independently, continue after failures and keep successful observations. A failed sibling verdict is not evidence against another row. Shared protocols reduce setup; they are not conjunctive bundles. When a setup step fails, set up the same thing again on a new job of your own...'; functional/prompt.md:7 'If a feature does not work as delivered, give that criterion its lowest score ... state what you observed, and move on.'; polish/prompt.md:12 'Otherwise judge each criterion independently and continue after failures.'; visual/prompt.md:12 'Otherwise grade every criterion independently with its five anchors and continue after failures.'; polish/visual prompt.md:16-18 'Preserve every completed independent observation.' The only all-zero instruction in each scored prompt is the in-dimension global browser gate (blank/static shell or failed shared-backend check), which the template itself mandates (template functional/prompt.md:13 'If the gate fails, assign 0 to every criterion') and is not a first-criterion-failure stop. Grep of all task tests/*.toml and *.md for stop|first fail|abort|halt|skip the rest|zero the rest found no stop-at-first-failure wording; the task even drops the template's 'Fail fast ... stop' line. Cross-row references in criteria assign ownership rather than chaining verdicts (functional/judge.toml:65 'Arrival of several cards together belongs to hro_bulk_move'; functional/prompt.md:39 Tomas fallback 'graded only in hro_candidate_linked' with seeded-conversation substitute so T/U/K rows remain observable). Per-row zero clauses in polish (judge.toml:23,32 'If no update arrives within 15 seconds ... this row is 0') are confined to that row. app_context.md (injected) contains no contrary wording. Gates (gates/{render,constraints}/judge.toml:15 aggregation = all_pass, scoring.toml gates weight 0.0) are exempt per workbook. Adversarial probes: (a) a broken app whose undo or interview-place rule fails mid-protocol could otherwise derail later protocol state and zero siblings; the functional prompt's re-setup-on-a-new-job instruction plus 'failed sibling verdict is not evidence' covers that; (b) a conforming app that refuses an action in the UI before sending is still covered by the replay instruction (functional/prompt.md:23), so it cannot be zeroed by a missing control. No wording permits one miss to zero the rest. Verification is static source review of frozen bytes (hashes recomputed this session); no configured judge run exists in raw-evidence-index.json (its scope states full configured grading is absent), so actual judge adherence to the wording is unmeasured, but this row grades the wording, which is fully observable in source. Out-of-scope observations for other rows (not deductions here): functional/prompt.md lacks the budget-exhaustion 'NOT EXERCISED - evaluator/tool limitation' paragraph that polish/visual carry, relevant to workload/timeout rows given the very long 43-criterion protocol at timeout 9000; polish hro_pol_live_board/hro_pol_live_thread zero when no live update arrives, which overlaps functional hro_live_board/hro_msg_exchange and belongs to the double-deduction/independence rows (28/related).
